# Templates and playbooks

Part XIV of the book is a library of working artifacts. Each template says which chapters use it, who
owns it, and how often it is used, and each includes a filled-in example from the fictional
[Northstar Technologies](../case-studies/northstar/index.md) case study, so that you can see what a
good entry looks like before writing your own.

Copy them freely; they are licensed CC BY 4.0 like the rest of the book. Adapt the fields to your
organization, and remove fields you will not use. A template with ten fields that people fill in is
more useful than one with thirty fields they skip.

## Available now

| Template | What it is for |
|---|---|
| [Engineering quality scorecard](engineering-quality-scorecard.md) | Paired quality measures with definitions, sources, and gaming audits |
| [Technical debt register](technical-debt-register.md) | Debt recorded by recurring cost, with decisions and owners |
| [Incident review](incident-review.md) | A blameless review that checks for recurrence and produces owned actions |
| [90-day quality transformation plan](ninety-day-quality-plan.md) | The first quarter of a quality transformation, from diagnosis to an agreed capacity trade |
| [Engineering Manager performance rubric](engineering-manager-rubric.md) | Six dimensions with observable evidence for assessing an engineering manager |
| [Director competency matrix](director-competency-matrix.md) | A director's competencies across levels, for self-assessment and development |
| [Organizational design assessment](organizational-design-assessment.md) | Teams, spans, dependencies, ownership, and cognitive load in one assessment |
| [Quarterly engineering review](quarterly-engineering-review.md) | A quarter's results, risks, and decisions for executives |
| [Capacity planning model](capacity-planning-model.md) | Capacity by category with planned and cautious cases |
| [Engineering strategy](engineering-strategy.md) | Diagnosis, guiding policies, and coherent actions on about two pages |
| [Technology investment business case](technology-investment-business-case.md) | Cost, value channels, cost of delay, payback, and sensitivity for one investment |
| [Stakeholder map](stakeholder-map.md) | One map per decision: power, interest, position, and an engagement plan |
| [Executive update](executive-update.md) | A one-page update to executives: results, risks, and the decisions asked for |
| [CTO competency matrix](cto-competency-matrix.md) | CTO competencies weighted by the kind of CTO the company needs, rated on evidence |
| [Risk register](risk-register.md) | Enterprise technology risks with owners, appetite, treatment decisions, and review dates |
| [Architecture decision record](architecture-decision-record.md) | One significant decision: context, options, the decision, its decider, and its consequences |

The remaining templates in the [curriculum](../curriculum.md) are planned and will be added with
the chapters that teach them.
